title: Intern- Dimensional Management
jobDescription:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together. The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: we come together, we always look for a better way, and we create possibilities. Interested in joining us on our journey? The Intern will be trained to support hands-on product development project while building core skills in CAD, GD&T, tolerance analysis, inspection, prototype review, and technical presentation. They will be guided on Dimensional Managements methodologies and different analysis approach to predict and analyse objectives and challenges in product build. Primary tools used will be Creo, 3DCS and Polyworks. Position Intern- Dimensional Management Location IND, Bangalore, KA How You'll Create Possibilities Understand the full product development lifecycle Build foundational knowledge in GD&T and dimensional control concepts Develop skills in locator design and datum flow planning Gain experience creating and refining CAD models and Model Based Definition in Creo Learn to evaluate design intent, critical gaps, and manufacturability considerations Apply tolerance analysis and variation awareness to support design decisions using 3DCS Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback into iterative improvements Gain exposure to prototype printing, part modification, and rework processes Learn basic inspection and measurement workflows using Poly Works What You'll Bring to Our Team

QUALIFICATIONS:
A student from final year M. Tech (M.tech 1st year completed) Excellent oral and written communication skills. A passion for technology and appetite to learn new things with limited guidance. Firsthand experience in MS office & visualization of engineering drawings Experience in Creo will be a plus. Skills & Attributes: Strong visualization skills to interpret problem statements, drawings, and figures accurately. Experience with CAD tools (Creo) Prior project experience involving Dimensional Management (academic or personal). Prior Model Based Definition and/or AI experience is a plus. What We Offer: Mentorship from experienced engineers and exposure to industry-leading projects. A dynamic and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth. Opportunities to contribute to impactful projects and make a difference in the engineering field. title: CAE Analyst
jobDescription:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together. The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: we come together, we always look for a better way, and we create possibilities. Interested in joining us on our journey? Provide a brief description of the general nature of the position; an overview of why the job exists today; and what the job is to accomplish. The job summary should be no more than 3-4 sentences. The CAE analyst (FEA) is responsible for structural and thermal, linear, nonlinear analysis, fatigue life calculations for LCF and HCF on components and complex sub-assemblies of appliance products. The person should have strong background in Machine Design, good understanding on preprocessing, post processing . The person should have good hands-on experience with software packages such as Abaqus, Hypermesh, PTC Creo or equivalent. Position CAE Analyst Location IND, Bangalore, KA How You'll Create Possibilities Essential Duties &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Describe the job’s key duties, responsibilities and activities in terms that enable anyone to understand what is required. Avoid using language or acronyms that are organizational-specific. Start by indicating the intended result of the activity. Scope and conduct Structural and Thermal, linear/non-linear (metals and plastics), design optimization analysis with limited domain guidance. Perform fatigue life calculations for LCF and HCF problems. Proven capability of working on assemblies with good complexity levels involving non-linearity and good hands-on knowledge on convergence resolution techniques. Solve coupled thermo-structural FEA problems & exposure to vibration and Explicit dynamic analysis will be added advantage. Provide insights on the product behavior under loading, confirm design feasibility & propose design changes to the product development team based on manufacturing processes knowledge. What You'll Bring to Our Team Position Requirement Work with limited domain guidance in cross-functional team environment, global CAE team, engineering labs during product design and development cycle. Coordinate with global Technology teams in creating novel design solutions and strategic IP for Appliances Technology Proven ability of problem-solving skills, self-learning abilities and shown track record of technical excellence. Good communication skills to interact with stake holders and FEA team. Demonstrate strong engineering fundamentals in Machine design, Materials and modeling as required for FEA analysis. Knowledge of parametric models/tools (DOE, automation) for various structural and thermal analysis. Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to enhance simulation accuracy, reduce computational time, and automate routine tasks.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

5 to 9 years of experience in FEA simulations (preferably for consumer appliances products). M. Tech / M.E degree in Mechanical Engineering

PREFERRED

Demonstrated ability to work on at least 2 projects in parallel. Demonstrated ability in numerical simulation and clear presentation of analysis results. title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - EPM
jobDescription:
Job Location Hyderabad (SAL) IN Job Posting Title Senior Business Systems Analyst
- EPM The Challenge The Business Systems Analyst – EPM is responsible for the development and design of the GEA’s Planning, Hyperion, HFM, DRM and Essbase applications in all environments. This individual will be integral to ongoing efforts to streamline and automate integration between all the applications, sourcing data from HFM and other sources, synchronizing metadata and data necessary within GEA to improve our efficiencies and reporting What you will Do Essential Duties & Responsibilities • Design, document, test and maintain all Hyperion, HFM, DRM, Planning and Essbase metadata and rules changes related to chart of accounts, entities, scenarios and custom members • Create and configure HFM, Planning, FDMEE objects such as rules, mappings, data grids, task lists and web forms • Develop and maintain application artifacts such as business rules, calc scripts, reports and rule scripts • Design and develop Oracle EPM reporting solutions, including OBIEE integration. • Assist with activities such as metadata and data loads, data conversion, consolidations, eliminations and reconciling data • Assist with project activities such as requirement gathering, design, development, testing, migration and deployment • Work with vendor on product issues and bugs • Assist with providing training to end-users • Assist in preparation of key deliverables such as requirement/design documents, test plans/cases, training materials and administration guides • Good knowledge of other EPM modules such as Essbase, DRM and ODI • Good knowledge on Windows batch,
